tools.name: kh_flows
tools.description: Find KH flows for a task, best first (id, what it does, its input). Use it when the turn context gave no TASK FLOW pack and the task has several steps.

tools.name: kh_flow
tools.description: Run one KH flow by id; answers one pack with everything it looked up.

tools.name: kh_map
tools.description: The task map of a space: at most 5,000 characters of pointers (best match, what, where, who, history) on what you can read. text = the task in a few words. space = a space id, default the session's bound space. Then open a pointer with kh_expand, look up a name, code or path with kh_find.

tools.name: kh_expand
tools.description: Open one row of a map: its text (or one section), its links and history. id = a pointer of the map (short id) or a qualified id space/scope/id.

id.description: the row id from the map

section.description: optional: one section of the row

space.description: only for a short id; default the session's

tools.name: kh_find
tools.description: Find the rows a key points to: a name, code, path or id as written (exact, not by meaning).

tools.name: kh_walk
tools.description: Follow the links of one row: the rows reached in 1 or 2 hops. id = a qualified id space/scope/id; links = optional link kinds, comma separated.

id.description: qualified id of the row to start from

tools.name: kh_flow_answer
tools.description: Answer a KH flow run that waits for you (status waiting): run_id from that answer; answer = what its ASK wants, in the ANSWER SHAPE given (a JSON object when the shape is one, else text). Answers the next ask or the result; a refused shape comes back with the reason.

answer.description: a JSON object in the asked shape, or text

tools.name: kh_project_status
tools.description: Project status: Where a project stands: About, latest work logs and open findings, in one pack.

project.description: the project (optional: the session's bound one)
